title: Clefable (Pokémon)
text:
Clefable (Japanese: ピクシー Pixy) is a Fairy-type Pokémon introduced in Generation I. Prior to Generation VI, it was a Normal-type Pokémon.
It evolves from Clefairy when exposed to a Moon Stone. It is the final form of Cleffa.
Clefable can Mega Evolve into Mega Clefable using the Clefablite. Mega Clefable was introduced in Pokémon Legends: Z-A.


== Biology ==
Clefable is a tall, pink Pokémon with a vaguely star-shaped body. It has long, pointed ears with dark brown tips and black, oval eyes with wrinkles on either side. A curled lock of fur hangs over its forehead, much like its long, tightly curled tail. On its back is a pair of dark pink wings; each wing has three points. Its hands have three fingers each, and its feet have two clawed toes and dark pink soles.
Clefable is a timid, nocturnal creature that flees when it senses people approaching and is one of the world's rarest Pokémon. Its sensitive ears can distinctly hear a pin drop from half a mile to 1,100 yards away. Because of its acute hearing, it prefers to live in quiet, mountainous areas of which it is protective. It has also been seen at deserted lakes during a full moon. Using a bouncy gait, it can walk on water and sometimes appears to be flying using its small wings. In the Pokémon the Series episode Clefairy Tales, Clefable is depicted as an extraterrestrial Pokémon. According to one tradition, seeing a pair of Clefable ensures a happy marriage. Some scientists believe Clefable stares intently at the moon because it is homesick. There is also a legend to this, which tells of how it listens for the voices of its kind on the moon during clear and quiet nights. As mentioned in Pokémon Sleep, Clefable is known to sleep in remote places during quiet, moonlit nights. It is theorized that Clefable is dreaming about its friends and distant homeland during its peaceful slumber.
Before Generation V, Clefable and its pre-evolved forms were the only known Pokémon that could have Magic Guard as an Ability.


=== Forms ===
Clefable can Mega Evolve into Mega Clefable.
Mega Clefable's most distinct feature is its transformation into a large, pink creature with butterfly-like wings. The main color of the wings is dark pink, with yellow at the bottom; the wings' colors may change if Mega Clefable performs certain moves. Each wing extends from a three-pronged main structure coming out of Mega Clefable's back. Mega Clefable's ears are longer and droop beside its body; each ear is tube-shaped with a light blue circular opening at each tip. Mega Clefable also has two dark pink cheek marks on its face. Its eyes are half white and half light blue. Additionally, the curled lock of its hair transforms into a round, hat-like shape, with the lower half being pink and the upper half being white, topped with a curled tip.
Despite having wings, Mega Clefable does not actually use them to fly; rather, it harnesses the power of moonlight to control gravity within a radius of over 32 feet (10 meters) around it, allowing it to levitate. Mega Clefable constantly emits sparkles around itself.


=== Evolution ===
Clefable evolves from Clefairy and is the final form of Cleffa.
(For specifics on this Pokémon's Evolution in the games, refer to Game data→Evolution data.)
